name: starlight-second-brain
description: Source-backed knowledge workflows: recover context, distill selected sources, trace decisions, verify synthesis and build offline knowledge explorers. Uses existing authorized tools; no hosted memory service.

interface.longDescription: Six focused workflows connect source discovery, atomic notes, decision history, verified reflection, context handoffs and a searchable offline graph/timeline explorer. Preserves existing GitHub, Drive, Notion and sovereign-vault ownership. Includes a validated deterministic packet compiler. Requires source connectors or supplied files; does not capture unseen chats or activate a hosted memory service.
defaultPrompt: Resume this project from its latest source-backed context.
Map my knowledge sources and trace the decisions that matter.
Turn these selected sources into an interactive knowledge map.
